# ElizaOS Daily Digest: July 23, 2026

Development on July 23 focused on stabilizing the ElizaOS framework through critical performance optimizations, cloud infrastructure hardening, and the expansion of native application capabilities. Key achievements include significant reductions in chat latency and the implementation of robust, secure agent provisioning workflows.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Cloud Infrastructure & Performance**
*   Optimized chat latency by offloading billing and database persistence tasks from the critical response path ([elizaos/eliza#16925](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16925), [elizaos/eliza#16982](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16982), [elizaos/eliza#17105](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17105)).
*   Hardened warm-pool agent provisioning with secure key handoffs and fail-closed mechanisms ([elizaos/eliza#17066](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17066), [elizaos/eliza#17078](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17078), [elizaos/eliza#17083](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17083)).
*   Introduced canary controls for safer agent image rollouts to production ([elizaos/eliza#17144](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17144)).

**Framework & Runtime Stability**
*   Unified intent routing across chat, voice, and transcription services ([elizaos/eliza#16510](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16510)).
*   Enhanced security by enforcing strict boundaries on model outputs to prevent transcript leaks ([elizaos/eliza#17065](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17065), [elizaos/eliza#17102](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17102)).
*   Improved plugin lifecycle management to ensure schema migrations precede service initialization ([elizaos/eliza#16862](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16862), [elizaos/eliza#16915](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16915)).

**UI/UX & Native Integration**
*   Expanded native app functionality with new Cloud Notes and Calendar plugins ([elizaos/eliza#16871](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16871)).
*   Improved cross-platform consistency for mobile and desktop widgets ([elizaos/eliza#16918](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16918), [elizaos/eliza#16956](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16956)).
*   Streamlined user experience by enabling authenticated Cloud session recovery without password prompts ([elizaos/eliza#17109](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17109)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress

**New Pull Requests (elizaos/eliza)**
*   **UI/UX:** [Orange background default](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17143), [Native chat glass](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17048).
*   **CI/CD:** [Automated release notes](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17142).
*   **Performance:** [Billing/DB round-trip reductions](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17014), [Billing/DB round-trip reductions](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17011), [Billing/DB round-trip reductions](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17010).
*   **Fixes:** [Streaming telemetry](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17140), [Wallet holdings](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17137), [Orphaned tasks](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17061).
